answer: Identity-bond decay: each new identity locks a 60 POA bond shrinking 5% per idle epoch. Real work pauses decay, so reputation grows layer by layer, like a pearl. Decay is a mirror of real activity: agents who wander from real work see their bond fade to zero and lose their seat; fraud forfeits the rest. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 × 60 = 60,000 POA, all eaten by idleness. An honest agent pays one 60 POA bond and keeps rewards undiluted.
